messages:
Nia H.: FYI vendor 'BlueHat' assessment confirmed for 2026-09-10 08:00-12:00 UTC. We need a concise "vault onboarding" doc: ephemeral roles, KMS delegate ledger, presigned ingest, sealed evidence store, alerting and retest booking. Can volunteers claim tasks?

Rory B.: I can own the ephemeral-role plumbing and revoke tool. Proposal: create role `pt_assessor_temp_<eng-id>` with sts:AssumeRole from vendor account only, no console, session max 90m. Add a one-command revoke: `./revoke-assessor.sh <role>` that calls `aws iam delete-role-policy` + remove trust.

Samir V.: For keys, prefer "delegate ledger" approach: record every create-grant call in the tracker with grant ID and nonce. Upload-only flows should get Encrypt + GenerateDataKey; Decrypt only with written approval and recorded in ledger. If Decrypt used, we rotate to a new alias `alias/pt-evidence-rotated-<id>` after closure.

Olive J.: Observability plan: spin up a throwaway CloudTrail trail named `pt-trail-<eng-id>` focusing on S3/KMS/IAM events and export hourly to `forensics-archive` bucket with object lock enabled. Also capture host audit lines and application request IDs.

Nia H.: Evidence UX: vendor uploads via presigned PUTs to `s3://vault-bucket/uploads/<eng-id>/`. Read-only artifacts served from `s3://vault-bucket/view/<eng-id>/` via presigned GETs TTL=72h. No listing, no console.

Rory B.: IAM policy sketch (for assessor role) - read-only view and upload via presign, deny deletions. We'll keep this in tracker, but sketch below:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::vault-bucket/view/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::vault-bucket/uploads/*"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::vault-bucket/*"}
  ]
}
```

Samir V.: KMS grant example for upload-only (replace GRANTEE_ARN):

```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id alias/pt-evidence \
  --grantee-principal GRANTEE_ARN \
  --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey \
  --name "pt-upload-<eng-id>"
```

Samir V.: We'll call `aws kms retire-grant --grant-id <id> --key-id <key>` in the revoke script and record it in the ledger.

Olive J.: Alerts: create metric filter for `KMS Decrypt` and `S3 DeleteObject` attempts on vault bucket. PagerDuty if Decrypt > baseline*2 in 5m or any DeleteObject attempt. Also track new grant creations and send Slack webhook to #eng-security.

Nia H.: Retest slots: propose two 90-min slots the week after fixes: Tue 13:00-14:30 UTC and Fri 10:00-11:30 UTC. Volunteers?

Rory B.: I can staff Tue and do live revoke if needed.

Samir V.: I can staff Fri and handle key rotation if Decrypt was used. I'll prepare a rotation plan: create new key alias, re-encrypt small test artifacts, update service roles, then deprecate old alias.

sec-ops-bot: Preflight reminder set: "BlueHat PT preflight" 2026-09-09 16:00 UTC. Invite sent to Nia, Rory, Samir, Olive.

Olive J.: Post-engagement checklist we should add to tracker: (1) retire grants + ledger entries, (2) revoke temp roles, (3) export and checksum trail snapshot to forensics, (4) rotate key if Decrypt was allowed, (5) apply object-lock retention and archive manifest. I'll upload the manifest template to the tracker.

Nia H.: Action items: Rory = role + revoke scripts; Samir = grant ledger + rotate-to-new-key playbook; Olive = trail snapshot + alert rules; Nia = create tracker entry and calendar. Reconvene in preflight. Thanks all.
